Create <run> in the OS temporary directory, then run from the project root:

```bash
node scripts/session-analysis.mjs insights --platform qoder --workspace . --selection all-eligible --limit 1000 --format json --output <run>/insights.json
node scripts/session-analysis/usage-review-packet.mjs --source <run>/insights.json --workspace . --limit 8 --output <run>/.review-packet.json
```

The private review packet resolves candidates locally. Write taskFamily, outcome, friction, confidence, and evidenceReason only for S1. Finish diagnosis before editing product code or creating a Memory, Skill, or Hook.

1 of 34 analyzed sessions (2.9%) crossed the estimated active-time threshold; the longest estimate was 45.6 minutes and 0 have reviewed outcomes. 3 additional long spans may be idle or resumed work. This is an investigation lead, not a confirmed efficiency, decomposition, tool, or model problem.

Without outcome review, complex work, tool friction, idle/resume noise, and a normal long task remain indistinguishable.

## Expected result

Each displayed candidate is classified by task family, outcome, and friction so the report can decide whether any real improvement is needed.

Create only a privacy-safe session-efficiency review and reader report. Do not edit product code or treat wall span as active cost. Durable reports keep aliases only; do not copy the private review packet into them. This is the complete 1/1 candidate view; conclusions still require semantic review.

<run>/.review.json has one valid row for each of S1; semantic review writes <run>/insights.reviewed.json; and <run>/report.md validates against the reviewed source. If review confirms no problem, do not create an improvement.
